summary: Backend-only testing of staff login fix (unified staff_users collection + sha256 + status:'active'). All 13 tests in test_connect_auth.py passed (100%), including all 5 requested scenarios: admin login, technician login, wrong credentials 401, /api/fix-admin returns 404, and /api/connect/me works with valid token.
critical_code_review_comments: Staff auth is now consistent: single collection (staff_users), single hash (sha256 via hash_password), single active flag (status: 'active').
Credentials seeded from env vars - good practice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff auth working perfectly after fix. Tests cover both roles, invalid credentials, fix-admin removal, and /api/connect/me. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_connect_auth.py -v
rca of the issue: Original bug: startup_seed_accounts wrote to db.technicians with bcrypt+active:True, but login read from db.staff_users expecting sha256+status:'active'. Fix unified everything to staff_users + sha256 + status:'active'. Verified working: admin & tech login both return success:true with correct roles.
